correctness.rationale: On the invariant polynomial observables P_N, the generator is triangular in degree with eigenvalues -j*kappa and -(j*kappa+a+b), j=0..N. At a+b=m*kappa, elimination at the lowest resonance gives F'(u)=C*u^(a/kappa)*(1-u)^(b/kappa-1); analyticity of a nonconstant polynomial forces both scaled positive rates to be integers, and their integrality constructs a second eigenfunction. The derivative commutator and polynomial-primitive lifting propagate semisimplicity/nonsemisimplicity to every later collision; each algebraic double eigenvalue without the second vector has exactly one 2x2 Jordan block. Direct rational moment-matrix checks corroborated protected and defective cases; no infinite-dimensional spectrum is asserted.
